content: Anita Sharma from Trust Wealth Advisors calls Pooja Bhatia to discuss the upcoming expiration of her health policy (HP-4521) on 30/09/2026. They discuss renewal options, including an 8% rate increase on the current plan, a lower-premium plan with a ₹10,000 deductible, and a 3-month short-term extension. Pooja is unsure about higher premiums and asks Anita to email the comparison sheet and renewal form to pooja.bhatia@example.com for review.

action_items: Email the comparison sheet and renewal form to pooja.bhatia@example.com
